description:
Edit repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/rhythm-reality-sync.ts. One file.

This resolver reads an open-gap count and uses it to recompute the gap-closing rhythm staleness. Two linked defects make it permanently suppress that rhythm.

CHANGE 1 - the timeout is shorter than the call. The gap_lifecycle_scan resolve is given a 2000 ms budget. Measured just now against the live substrate on three consecutive runs it takes 3749, 5350 and 5132 ms, so the abort fires every time. Raise that 2000 to 15000. The literal to change is the line containing only:
      2000,
which is the second argument of the fetchWithTimeout call that posts the gap_lifecycle_scan impulse. Do not change any other timeout in the file.

CHANGE 2 - and this is the important one - the failure path coerces UNKNOWN into a MEANINGFUL value. This line occurs exactly once, indented with six spaces:
      openGapCount = typeof data?.body?.open === "number" ? data.body.open : 0;
On a timeout, a non-ok response, or a missing field, openGapCount becomes 0, and 0 does not mean unknown here - it means the backlog is empty. staleness is then computed as min(1, openGapCount / targetBacklog) = 0 and written back, marking the family whose job is draining gaps as having nothing to do. With 1038 gaps currently open the gap-closing rhythm can never become due.

Introduce a boolean, declared alongside the existing openGapCount declaration and initialised false, that records whether a real count was obtained. Set it true ONLY on the branch where the numeric field was actually present. Leave it false in the catch and on a non-ok response.

Then guard the recomputation: when that boolean is false, skip the staleness recomputation and the write-back entirely and leave the stored staleness untouched. Abstaining preserves the last known-good value; writing a fabricated zero destroys it. Report the abstention in the returned body by carrying the flag, so a caller can tell an abstention from a genuine zero backlog.

Do not change how staleness is computed when the count IS known, do not touch the other rhythm families, and edit no other file.
